verses.html: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.text: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

verses.html: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.text: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

verses.html: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.text: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.

verses.html: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.text: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

verses.html: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

verses.html: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.text: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

verses.html: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.text: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

verses.html: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.text: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

verses.html: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

verses.html: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.text: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.html: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.text: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.html: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.text: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

verses.html: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.text: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

verses.html: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.text: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.

verses.html: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.text: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.html: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.text: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

verses.html: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.text: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

verses.html: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.text: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

verses.html: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.text: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

verses.html: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.text: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

verses.html: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.text: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

verses.html: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.text: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.html: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.text: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

verses.html: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.text: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

verses.html: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.text: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

verses.html: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.text: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

verses.html: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.text: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

verses.html: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.text: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

verses.html: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.text: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
